name: Chiteki na Jukujo Erorist ~Man'in Densha de Otto ni Kakurete Taninbou Shibori~
original_name: 痴的な熟女エロリスト ～満員電車で夫に隠れて他人棒搾り～
source:
One day, she was molested by a maniac on a crowded train. When she didn't resist, the act escalated and she experienced such a pleasure that her “womanhood” was awakened.

"I want to taste that pleasure one more time..."

Even if you get on a crowded train with your feelings in your heart, the majority of men in general do not molest women. 

"It's normal men who don't molest people, right?"

"...Then how about I do it myself...?"

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_179.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
有一天，她在拥挤的火车上被一名疯子猥亵。当她不反抗时，行为升级，她体验到了如此快感，以至于她的“女人味”被唤醒。

“我想再尝一次那种快乐……”

即使怀揣着感情登上拥挤的火车，大多数男性一般也不会猥亵女性。

“正常男人不会猥亵人的吧？”

“……那我自己来怎么样？”
